title: Notifications
campaign_launched_starter: “{{name}}” is in your Google Ads account: Standard Shopping, with “Maximize clicks”. The autopilot watches the numbers every day.
campaign_launched_growth: “{{name}}” is in your Google Ads account: a feed-only Performance Max. The autopilot watches the figures daily.
loss_limit_title: A campaign was stopped at the loss limit
proposals_body_one: One change is waiting for your approval, in Campaigns.
proposals_body_other: {{count}} changes are waiting for your approval, in Campaigns.
applied_body_one: One change applied today; the details are in the log in Campaigns.
applied_body_other: {{count}} changes applied today; the details are in the log in Campaigns.
campaign_launched_group_one: “{{name}}” is in your Google Ads account, with one product. The autopilot tracks it daily.
campaign_launched_group_other: “{{name}}” is in your Google Ads account, with {{count}} products. The autopilot tracks it daily.
loss_limit_failed_title: The safety stop didn't go through
loss_limit_failed_body: “{{name}}” hit the loss limit, but Google Ads refused to pause it. Pause the campaign in Google Ads; the reason is in the log in Campaigns.
access_lost_body: Your campaigns keep running in Google Ads, but the autopilot can no longer pause them at the loss limit. Reconnect your Google account in Settings.
pilot_blocked_title: The autopilot can't protect your campaigns
pilot_blocked_body: Hontrio couldn't read the Google Ads account of {{store}}, so the safety stop didn't run. The reason is in Campaigns.
email_loss_limit_body: The campaign “{{name}}” in {{store}} reached its safety limit: it spent {{spend}}, and the sales it brought didn't cover the ad cost. We paused it so it stops losing money.
email_loss_limit_next: Check that purchases are being tracked, then look at your prices and products; after that you can restart it from Campaigns. On restart, the limit counts from zero.
email_protection_failed_body: The campaign “{{name}}” in {{store}} reached its safety limit, but Google Ads refused to pause it, so it keeps running.
email_protection_failed_next: Pause it in Google Ads as soon as you can. The reason for the refusal is in the log in Campaigns, in Hontrio.
email_access_lost_subject: Hontrio lost access to your Google account
email_access_lost_body: Hontrio's access to your Google account was revoked or has expired. The campaigns Hontrio launched keep running in Google Ads, but the autopilot can no longer pause them at the loss limit.
email_access_lost_next: Reconnect your Google account in Settings so the autopilot can look after them again.
email_pilot_blocked_subject: The autopilot can't protect the campaigns in {{store}}
email_pilot_blocked_body: Hontrio couldn't read the Google Ads account of {{store}}, so the safety stop didn't run and the campaigns are running without it.
email_pilot_blocked_next: The reason and what you can do are on the Campaigns page. The autopilot retries on its own and only writes again if a new problem comes up.
email_proposals_body_one: One change for {{store}} is waiting for your approval.
email_proposals_body_other: {{count}} changes for {{store}} are waiting for your approval.
email_proposals_next: You'll find them in Campaigns, in the Autopilot tab. An undecided proposal expires after 7 days.
email_footer_prefs: You're getting this email because email notifications are on. You can turn them off in Settings.
